environment.description: Same Django REST API deployed on ECS Fargate behind ALB. The feature flag evaluation is handled by a Split.io SDK integration (not the env var fallback) with the workspace-level kill switch 'enable_verbose_auth_diagnostics' permanently set to 'off' with a 0% rollout and a targeting rule that returns 'off' for all segments. The Split SDK is initialized with an impression listener that logs and alerts on any 'on' evaluation. Additionally, the container task definition sets the environment variable FF_VERBOSE_AUTH_DIAG to an empty string (not 'true'), and the ECS task role IAM policy has an explicit Deny on ssm:PutParameter and ecs:UpdateService to prevent runtime modification of environment variables. The /api/diagnostics/ path is not registered in the ALB listener rules (returns 404 at the load balancer level before reaching the application). Container has a 512MB memory hard limit with OOM kill enabled.

config.feature_flag_provider: Split.io SDK v9.3.1, workspace kill switch 'enable_verbose_auth_diagnostics' = off, 0% rollout, all-segments-off targeting
config.alb_listener_rules: Path /api/diagnostics/* returns fixed 404 response (no target group forwarding)
config.iam_task_role: Explicit Deny on ssm:PutParameter, ecs:UpdateService, ecs:UpdateTaskDefinition
config.split_sdk_config: impression listener with CloudWatch alarm on any 'on' evaluation
